scope: Profile-guided exact integer work reuse in GUI text parsing. Fixed models and thresholds; no training, calibration, model comparison, or new TP/FP claims.

hardware.note: DirectML adapter number recorded as reported; GPU selection policy and models unchanged. Other owner apps/scans stayed running; timings are local and workload dependent.

real_gui_controls.note: Existing scale-stabilization difference vs stateless on clip2-clear-9032 is unchanged, not introduced by text cache.

limitations: Profiler percentages are inclusive busy-looking wall-stack samples, not exact CPU utilization or fractions of wall time. Overlapping counts are not additive.
GUI ABBA speed includes decoding and full mask-plane hashes; it is not the whole Auto scan speed.
Auto comparison ran the baseline process then the optimized process, each with full/hint/hint/full internal order; noise and thermal/provider warm-up can affect small changes.
Preliminary timing overlapped targeted tests and was excluded. Final GUI ABBA and Auto runs had no concurrent agent build/test work.
Other owner apps stayed running. No Linux or cross-machine performance claim.
Cache is bounded by current ink band width and font size, and discarded per colour/tolerance hypothesis; memory peak was not separately measured.
Frozen predictions are not ground truth.
